notes: The two שָׁנָה tokens stand in separate numeral phrases (age formula, reign length), each with its own written *years*, so rule 22's tail-to-tail repetition does not arise; each waw has one *and* (rule 42).
*his mother's name*: rule 29's possessive paragraph puts the determiner on the possessor — suffix takes *his*, אֵם takes *mother's* — and the copula before *Abi* joins the predicate (rule 20).
